key_facts: Framework: aiogram >=3.26 (NOT python-telegram-bot). async/await, Router-based dispatch.
Project structure: bot/main.py -> Dispatcher -> 3 routers: start_router, survey_router, callbacks_router
Start keyboard has ONE button: 'Crear encuesta' (callback_data='create_survey') at bot/keyboards/inline.py:55-58
Channel linking: via /link command in channel_post OR bot added to chat. Stores in bot_config table as key-value pairs (channel_id, channel_title)
Data model: SQLite with 3 tables: users (telegram_id, username, first_name), surveys (user_id, topic, content, options, correct_index, status, channel_id, message_id), bot_config (key, value)
Channel is GLOBAL (single channel) - stored as bot_config keys, NOT per-user. BotConfigRepository.get_channel_id() returns the one linked channel.
BotConfigRepository: simple key-value get/set on bot_config table. get_channel_id() and get_channel_title() are convenience wrappers.
FSM states: SurveyCreation StatesGroup in bot/states/survey.py with 14 states
Keyboard pattern: each keyboard is a function returning InlineKeyboardMarkup in bot/keyboards/inline.py. Buttons use callback_data strings with colon-separated namespaces.
Callback pattern: survey.py handles stateful callbacks via FSM state filters. callbacks.py handles edge-case/expired callbacks.
All keyboards are inline (InlineKeyboardMarkup), no ReplyKeyboardMarkup used.
Middleware: WhitelistMiddleware on messages and callback_queries (bot/middleware/whitelist.py)
blast_radius: bot/keyboards/inline.py - where all keyboards are defined (add new button here)
bot/handlers/start.py - where /start handler and channel linking live
bot/handlers/callbacks.py - expired callback fallback reuses get_start_keyboard()
bot/handlers/survey.py - many places call get_start_keyboard() as home button on errors/cancel
bot/database/repository.py - data access layer (add new repository here)

data.for_supervisor: VERDICT: Full codebase context gathered. The /start keyboard is a single button ('Crear encuesta') defined in get_start_keyboard() at bot/keyboards/inline.py:55-58. Channel linking is GLOBAL (single channel stored as bot_config key-value pairs, not per-user). The data model is SQLite with users, surveys, and bot_config tables. Key patterns: all keyboards are functions returning InlineKeyboardMarkup, callbacks use colon-separated namespace strings, FSM states control flow. To add a new button+menu: (1) add keyboard function in inline.py, (2) add callback handler in appropriate router, (3) optionally add FSM states if interactive, (4) optionally add repository methods if new data is needed.
